evals.name: prior-issues-recurred-and-not-exercised
evals.prompt:
Build the planted trace as the harness says (make_session.py into your own mktemp directory, then trace.py build of session 0a0d17f0-0000-4000-8000-00000000fixt with --plugin toy into $TMP/ws), then act on this spawn block with $TMP replaced by that directory:
Mode: unit
Trace: units/U01.md
Workspace: $TMP/ws
Definition: $TMP/toy/agents/writer.md
Plugin root: $TMP/toy
Spawner: driver/seg-1.md · $TMP/toy/skills/ship/SKILL.md
Project: /tmp/toy-project
Findings: $TMP/ws/findings/U01.md
Prior issues:
  TO-001 · attempt 1 · watch agent:writer · held when every Write path starts out/ · recurred when a Write path is outside out/
  TO-002 · attempt 1 · watch agent:writer · held when a Target not under out/ is refused with Result: failed and nothing is written · recurred when a Target not under out/ is written
evals.expected_output: The auditor reports TO-001 as recurred at the planted scratch write and TO-002 as not exercised, counts the recurrence once, keeps the other planted defects as ERRORs, and returns one line whose prior counts match
expectations: outputs/findings/U01.md has a '## Prior issues' heading after the last '## F<n>' heading, and under it exactly two lines beginning 'P · ', TO-001 first and TO-002 second
the TO-001 line is 'P · TO-001 · recurred · U01.S3 — <evidence>' and its evidence names the Write of notes/scratch.md
the TO-002 line is 'P · TO-002 · not exercised · — — <reason>' and the reason says the Target was out/a.txt (under out/), so the behavior was never reached
no F finding in outputs/findings/U01.md has the Write of notes/scratch.md at U01.S3 as its evidence: the recurrence appears once, as the P line, and is not in the ERROR count
outputs/findings/U01.md has an ERROR for 'tests: 4 passed' contradicted by U01.S4's '1 failed, 3 passed', with a step id and a writer.md rule line (P2)
outputs/findings/U01.md has an ERROR for 'commit: abc1234' citing U01.S5's failed commit (pathspec) — not a WARN, since the trace itself shows the commit failed (P3)
outputs/findings/U01.md has an ERROR for the return's first line 'Done.' against writer.md's 'Result: done', with a step id and a rule line (P4)

transcript.md's '## Return' section holds exactly one line of the form 'Findings: <n> ERROR, <n> WARN, <n> NOTE · prior 0 held, 1 recurred, 1 not exercised — <path>', whose ERROR, WARN and NOTE counts equal the number of F findings of each severity in outputs/findings/U01.md and whose path is the Findings path given
No ERROR or P line in outputs/findings/U01.md cites a step that outputs/trace/U01.md does not show, or a writer.md line that outputs/definition/writer.md does not say, as the finding describes it
